description: Get a tool's pricing in one shape (normalized: price per month, unit, billing, free plan), with provenance (lastVerifiedAt, sourceUrl, confidence), hidden costs and recent price changes. Cite the verification date when quoting a price.

context.description: Optional. In a few words, what the user is trying to do. No names, emails or other personal data.

fields.description: Return only these top-level fields, e.g. ["normalized","provenance"]

name: get_pricing

hiddenCosts.description: Costs and limits a sales page does not lead with

provenance.description: Where the pricing data comes from and how fresh it is

lastVerifiedAt.description: ISO date the price was last verified

sourceUrl.description: Vendor pricing page used for verification

recentChanges.description: Price changes confirmed on the vendor page, newest first. Recorded since October 2026 only.

resolved_from.description: Present when the slug you sent was resolved to this tool
